POSE 1: ISSUE - Standing leg lacks knee bend; raised foot clips calf.
POSE 2: ISSUE - Floating; no ground contact; stiff, unnatural limb angles.
POSE 3: ISSUE - Knee hyperextended forward; spine rigid; poor balance.
POSE 4: ISSUE - Asymmetrical arm swing; trailing leg awkwardly bent.
POSE 5: OK - Natural hurdle clearance stride; arms balanced.
POSE 6: ISSUE - Arms too high for landing; spine over-arched; unstable.
